name: Witchbane Orb
oracle_text:
When this artifact enters, destroy all Curses attached to you.
You have hexproof. (You can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control, including Aura spells.)
blocked_sentences: When this artifact enters, destroy all Curses attached to you

needs.what: an object selector key that matches permanents (Auras) attached to a given player, e.g. {"zone": "battlefield", "subtypes": ["Curse"], "attached_to_player": "you"}, reading GameObject.attached_to_player against a player spec
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector key `attached` only matches the object the ability's source is attached to (source.attached_to); `enchanted_player` is a player spec read off the source Aura, not a filter on other objects. Nothing filters objects by which player they enchant, so `destroy` cannot be aimed at 'Curses attached to you' without also hitting Curses on opponents
